detectorBugs: Clone tokenizer (`src/detectors/clones-tokenize.ts`) truncates files that contain a template literal type. `TemplateLiteralType` nodes are not in the skip ranges, so the raw `ts.createScanner` mis-scans the `}` that closes `${...}` and swallows the rest of the file. Reproducer: hono `src/jsx/intrinsic-elements.ts` (928 lines) emits no tokens after line 705 (`image/${string}`); hono `src/types.ts` (2783 lines) stops at line 2733 (`${infer R}?`). Effect: `code/duplicate-block` cannot see clones below that line. Other rules are unaffected (an appended `any` and `setTimeout` at lines 926/927 are both reported). Not fixed in this round.
